testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and reopens one drawing browser branch ✔ Given a drawing with a sheet and drawing resources is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the sheet and drawing resources branches are expanded in the browser ✔ And the nested title block branch is expanded ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch ✔ Then the sheet branch collapses and its child entries are hidden ✔ And the drawing resources branch remains expanded ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch again ✔ Then the sheet branch expands and its child entries are displayed ✔ And the nested title block branch appears expanded ✔ And the drawing resources branch remains expanded
